title: Kamishiro Rui — Fantastic Planner〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey! I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, that makes everyone.
Let's get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, there's a video I want to show you guys first! One of my friends from class told me about it...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's... That's... Nooo! That's the show I was supposed to be a part of!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Keep it down...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. You were supposed to be an extra for a wedding, right, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was, but something unfortunate happened. I had a friend of mine go in my place...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something unfortunate?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He had food poisoning, so Aoyagi ended up taking his place.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Aoyagi as in the one from my class...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shinonome came to help as well. Even one of the hall monitors joined in at the last minute.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, maybe they're in the video too!
What do they look like?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lemme see... No, I don't think they're in this shot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's too bad...
But I didn't know that they were your friends, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Friends? I mean, we've talked a little before...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I already thanked them when we were at school, but I still need to pay them back someday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but you've known Aoyagi for a while now, right, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aoyagi seems to be one of Tsukasa's biggest fans. It's curious how he ended up having to take his place for this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He did very well for himself too. His hard-working attitude was a real lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A lifesaver? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa actually asked me to go check on him and the overall situation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I remember from the night festival that he was quite the singer, but then I learned that he didn't have any acting experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More things came up after that and I ended up having to direct the whole performance...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! You're saying that you did all this?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Well, the groundwork was already laid out. All I did was make a few adjustments.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't know that! Did you come up with the bang-zoom-boom part in the end too, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Correct! Well done, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆ I got it right♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hold on...
They were okay with all of that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As you can see, everything was a big success. I could not ask for a happier crowd...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I got that much, but that's not what I'm talking about...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What I mean is, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You haven't done anything like this with other people in a really long time, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate your concern.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know full well that not all of my ideas will pan out. I understand that they're not for everyone and some even openly disagreed with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still don't like the way you do things, Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I know that feeling of wanting to make something happen no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When everyone realized that we were doing it all for the bride and the groom, they became much more understanding and gave it their best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I learned that it's important to have a common goal to work towards despite any differences we may have.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then good for you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nonetheless, I still have much to learn, and my mistakes from then will surely help us later on.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. Don't get so down now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're Wonderlands×Showtime! We're the ones that give your shows 20,000%!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, another unprovable claim? That value's grown since last time as well, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's because we have Emu and Nene now! Of course it's gone up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui, just tell us what you want us to do and we'll do it☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't have superpowers like these two, so don't forget to go easy on me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I will. Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I couldn't ask for more...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can as a director too.)
